Pixovia Ecosystem

Pixovia offers multiple active platforms:
- Pixovia File Library: A secure, fast platform for uploading, sharing, and discovering files online.
- Pixovia Chat: Connect securely and chat seamlessly. Join the global Pixovia Chat room, connect with friends, and share high-quality media with zero latency.
- Pixovia Learn: A complete learning and study application.
- Pixovia Sites: A community platform for creating, hosting and exploring small HTML websites.
- Pixovia Drive: A robust cloud storage app for Android and Web. (Download APK: https://github.com/pixovia/pixovia.github.io/releases/v1.0.drive/download/pixovia-drive.apk)
- Pixovia Tube: A feature-complete video platform for long-form videos, Shorts, and playlists (https://ptube.pages.dev).
- Pixovia Blogs: A publishing platform supporting guest and account-based blogging, AI prompt-to-blog creation, AI blog enhancement, and AI-generated post summaries (https://pixovia-blogs.pages.dev).
- Pixovia Music: A completely free music downloader with multi-quality support. (Download: Coming Soon)

Downloads are available at /download.

Legacy Open Source:
Please note that we had a previous version of Pixovia which is now fully open source. The entire legacy codebase—including the frontend, backend, and the full database—is available at github.com/pixovia.
Importantly, the new Pixovia File Library features a completely changed infrastructure with significantly more features and enhancements compared to the legacy open source version.
